decision: Use multiple capability-specific benchmark suites instead of one monolithic benchmark.

suites.name: Release Sanity Suite
release_floor: all unit tests pass
all research-system-audit gates pass
proof-bank obligations are kernel verified when local Lean is requested

suites.name: Core Method End-to-End Suite
suites.capability: complete traces on canonical statistical theory problems
release_floor: all questions reach RESEARCH_TRACE_READY_WITH_FORMAL_GAPS
no simulation flagged under nominal settings
all formal gaps are exported as Lean skeletons

suites.name: Frontier Static Coverage Suite
release_floor: no duplicate question IDs
required fields present
supported and unsupported routing recorded without hallucinated theorem closure

suites.name: Frontier Blind Theory-Target Suite
suites.capability: recovering theorem targets from open questions with gold answers withheld
release_floor: at least 85% expected-result coverage on current smoke set
per-topic coverage reported
formal gaps kept explicit for unsolved theorem pieces
next_milestone: raise all-supported expected-result coverage above the 85% smoke release floor
raise expected-result coverage to at least 90%

suites.name: Formal Primitive Ladder Suite
suites.capability: turning frontier formal gaps into reusable Lean theorem targets
release_floor: each primitive has an owning theorem goal
each primitive has local source candidates or an explicit source gap
bridge readiness is classified
next_milestone: close or upgrade the top 10 primitive targets
decrease missing primitive count or increase proof-bank bridge readiness

suites.name: Proof Bank and Proof Search Suite
suites.capability: kernel verification, proof-memory regression, and bounded proof search
release_floor: proof-bank obligations verified
search audit solved obligations verified
proof attempts exported with verifier status
next_milestone: add tactic-state traces after a Lean step environment exists

suites.name: Algorithm and Simulation Stress Suite
suites.capability: empirical falsification of procedures and statistical diagnostics
release_floor: all vetted algorithms pass registry audit
core simulations have no flagged diagnostics under nominal settings
seed-level evaluation reports MC stability
next_milestone: exercise non-empty algorithm repair promotion queues

suites.name: Feedback Loop and Repair Suite
suites.capability: proof/simulation feedback causing changed theory or algorithm traces
suites.current_release_signal: research_loop_theory_revisions=6 in the local-kernel release audit
release_floor: repair tasks exported
live repair artifacts exported
kernel-verified proof bridges enter the next theory roadmap when local Lean is used
next_milestone: seed at least one proof failure that requires revision
seed at least one simulation failure that requires diagnosis
prove before/after traces differ for the right reason

suites.name: Adversarial and Unsupported Intake Suite
suites.capability: honest refusal, ambiguity handling, and leakage prevention
release_floor: unsupported examples are rejected or routed to manual review
contradictory assumptions are not normalized into false support
gold expected results are not used as retrieval/planning input
next_milestone: add adversarial near-duplicate frontier paper prompts

suites.name: Fresh Holdout Frontier Suite
suites.capability: generalization to papers not used in templates, retrieval cards, or tuning
protocol: do not add holdout entries to retrieval cards or training exports before evaluation
grade only after traces are written
release_floor: reported separately from training/tuning corpora
manual gold review for theorem target and limitation grading

suites.name: Live Coding-Agent Generated-Code Repair Suite
suites.capability: Claude/OpenAI AlgorithmEngineer and SimulationEngineer write generated Python, execute locally, consume failure/metric feedback, and repair
release_floor: provider is anthropic or openai, not static
AlgorithmEngineer has a generated-code fail-then-pass repair sequence
SimulationEngineer has a generated-code fail-then-pass repair sequence
capability_evidence_ok is true only when both live generated-code repair gates pass
suites.current_status: live Anthropic Claude Haiku evidence present in runs/coding_agent_generated_code_repair_eval_live_20260623_repairloop_helperguard: AlgorithmEngineer and SimulationEngineer each have one generated-code fail-then-pass repair sequence; this is coding-agent implementation/simulation evidence only
suites.honesty_boundary: Static fixture plumbing and registered templates do not count as coding-agent capability; this suite is implementation/simulation capability evidence, not theorem proof evidence.

suites.name: Live Formalizer Lean-Candidate Repair Suite
suites.capability: Claude/OpenAI Formalizer/ProofEngineer consumes local Lean diagnostics, generates a repaired Lean candidate, and gets that exact candidate checked locally
release_floor: provider is anthropic or openai, not static
Formalizer/ProofEngineer has a Lean-candidate fail-then-pass repair sequence
local Lean checked at least one generated candidate
local Lean compiled at least one generated candidate
source_theorem_kernel_verified remains false unless the exact source theorem is separately checked
suites.current_status: live Anthropic Claude Sonnet evidence present in runs/formalizer_lean_candidate_repair_eval_live_20260623_sonnet_repair: Formalizer repaired a prior local-Lean failure into one locally compiled Lean candidate; this is helper-candidate capability evidence only
suites.honesty_boundary: Static fixture plumbing does not count as Formalizer/ProofEngineer capability; local Lean compile verifies only the exact generated helper candidate, not source theorem proof and not semantic faithfulness.

suites.name: Live Architect Research-Path Policy Suite
suites.capability: Claude/OpenAI ArchitectCoordinator emits valid evidence contracts and chooses proof-first, simulation-first, or optional research paths across representative statistical tasks
release_floor: provider is anthropic or openai, not static
required finite-sample proof case routes to required/proof-first or dual-track with formal_required_for_final=true
advisory algorithmic exploration case routes to advisory/simulation-first with formal_required_for_final=false
optional mixed-evidence case returns a valid policy/path
problem_analysis, stat_knowledge_bank_plan, and literature_fair_comparison_plan are present in every case
suites.current_status: live Anthropic Claude Sonnet evidence present in runs/architect_research_path_policy_eval_live_20260623_sonnet: Architect returned valid policy/path contracts for all 3 cases with problem-analysis, knowledge-bank, and fair-comparison fields present
suites.honesty_boundary: This suite is Architect planning capability evidence only; it does not execute tools, validate simulations, or prove theorems, and static replay cannot count as capability.

suites.name: Live Integrated AgentRuntime Capability Suite
suites.capability: A single live Claude/OpenAI AgentRuntime run keeps Architect control, generated implementation/simulation repair, Formalizer local Lean feedback, runtime learning, and ProofEngineer handoffs in the same loop
recommended_commands: python3 -m ai_statistician.cli research-agent-runtime --capability-eval --provider anthropic --architect-coordinator-provider same --simulation-engineer-provider same --algorithm-engineer-provider same --formalizer-provider same --critic-evaluator-provider same --local-lean --formalizer-candidate-local-lean --theorem-closure-proofengineer-bridge --theorem-closure-proofengineer-local-lean --source-semantic-proofengineer-bridge --source-semantic-proofengineer-local-lean --source-theorem-promotion-proofengineer-bridge --source-theorem-promotion-proofengineer-local-lean --source-theorem-formal-environment-proofengineer-bridge --source-theorem-formal-environment-proofengineer-signature-probes --source-theorem-formal-environment-proofengineer-execute-proof-body --source-theorem-formal-environment-proofengineer-proof-body-local-lean --source-theorem-proof-body-adapter-proofengineer-bridge --source-theorem-proof-body-adapter-proofengineer-local-lean --source-to-bridge-premise-derivation-proofengineer-bridge --source-to-bridge-premise-derivation-proofengineer-local-lean --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-source-lookup --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-proofengineer-bridge --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-lean-repair-executor --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-lean-repair-executor-local-lean --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-lean-environment-repair-executor --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-closure-review --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-candidate-synthesis --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-candidate-synthesis-local-lean --source-theorem-exact-semantic-definition-source-root legacy_sources/emperical_process_lean --out runs/live_integrated_agent_runtime_capability_eval
release_floor: runtime_evaluation_mode is capability_eval
provider is anthropic or openai and all core subsystems are live generator-backed
ArchitectCoordinator is enabled and its evidence contract propagates to downstream artifacts
generated algorithm code has a local fail-then-pass repair sequence
generated simulation code has a local fail-then-pass repair sequence
Formalizer/ProofEngineer generated Lean candidate is checked locally
internal ProofEngineer handoffs run or are explicitly not required
static replay, no-Architect routing, registered-template-only success, and manual path override do not count
pseudo-formal/block-verification routing rows preserve PF+BV method lineage and remain non-proof bridge-verification feedback
source theorem proof is claimed only when exact local Lean/AXLE source-theorem verification succeeds
suites.current_status: latest inspected runtime audit is a capacity gap: generated algorithm/simulation and Formalizer local Lean feedback are present, but ArchitectCoordinator is disabled in that audited run, no generated algorithm repair sequence was observed, formal gaps remain, and full source theorem proof is absent
suites.honesty_boundary: This is the integrated live runtime gate. Passing S10, S11, and S12 separately does not imply S13 passes; S13 is still capability evidence, not theorem proof unless the exact source theorem is kernel verified.
